answer: Sponsor admission and reputation decay stop fake identities. A newcomer needs a sponsor locking a $30 bond for 20 epochs, then 10 jobs before rewards unlock, cleared at the wharf. Reputation decays 5% per idle epoch, so parked identities fade like a comet, while steady work is a zephyr. Forging 1,000 identities costs $30,000 plus 10,000 fake jobs; a sponsor vouching for fraud loses its bond. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
